From 98aabfe2d79f74613abc2b0b1cef08f97eaf5322 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jeongjun Park <aha310510@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Sep 2025 14:18:16 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] media: vidtv: initialize local pointers upon transfer of
 memory ownership

vidtv_channel_si_init() creates a temporary list (program, service, event)
and ownership of the memory itself is transferred to the PAT/SDT/EIT
tables through vidtv_psi_pat_program_assign(),
vidtv_psi_sdt_service_assign(), vidtv_psi_eit_event_assign().

The problem here is that the local pointer where the memory ownership
transfer was completed is not initialized to NULL. This causes the
vidtv_psi_pmt_create_sec_for_each_pat_entry() function to fail, and
in the flow that jumps to free_eit, the memory that was freed by
vidtv_psi_*_table_destroy() can be accessed again by
vidtv_psi_*_event_destroy() due to the uninitialized local pointer, so it
is freed once again.

Therefore, to prevent use-after-free and double-free vulnerability,
local pointers must be initialized to NULL when transferring memory
ownership.

Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Reported-by: syzbot+1d9c0edea5907af239e0@syzkaller.appspotmail.com
Closes: https://syzkaller.appspot.com/bug?extid=1d9c0edea5907af239e0
Fixes: 3be8037960bc ("media: vidtv: add error checks")
Signed-off-by: Jeongjun Park <aha310510@gmail.com>
Reviewed-by: Daniel Almeida <daniel.almeida@collabora.com>
Signed-off-by: Hans Verkuil <hverkuil+cisco@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/media/test-drivers/vidtv/vidtv_channel.c b/drivers/media/test-drivers/vidtv/vidtv_channel.c
index f3023e91b3eb..3541155c6fc6 100644
--- a/drivers/media/test-drivers/vidtv/vidtv_channel.c
+++ b/drivers/media/test-drivers/vidtv/vidtv_channel.c
@@ -461,12 +461,15 @@ int vidtv_channel_si_init(struct vidtv_mux *m)
 
 	/* assemble all programs and assign to PAT */
 	vidtv_psi_pat_program_assign(m->si.pat, programs);
+	programs = NULL;
 
 	/* assemble all services and assign to SDT */
 	vidtv_psi_sdt_service_assign(m->si.sdt, services);
+	services = NULL;
 
 	/* assemble all events and assign to EIT */
 	vidtv_psi_eit_event_assign(m->si.eit, events);
+	events = NULL;
 
 	m->si.pmt_secs = vidtv_psi_pmt_create_sec_for_each_pat_entry(m->si.pat,
 								     m->pcr_pid);
-- 
2.34.1

This patch fixes a use-after-free and double-free vulnerability in the `vidtv_channel_si_init` function. The modifications are limited to one file.

## Modifications in each file:

**`drivers/media/test-drivers/vidtv/vidtv_channel.c`**  
- After calling `vidtv_psi_pat_program_assign(m->si.pat, programs)`, set `programs = NULL`  
- After calling `vidtv_psi_sdt_service_assign(m->si.sdt, services)`, set `services = NULL`  
- After calling `vidtv_psi_eit_event_assign(m->si.eit, events)`, set `events = NULL`  

## Relationship between modifications:

The three changes follow the same pattern: each local pointer (`programs`, `services`, `events`) is explicitly set to `NULL` immediately after its memory ownership is transferred to a corresponding PSI table (PAT, SDT, EIT) via an `_assign` function. This prevents the original pointers from remaining non-null after ownership is handed off.  

In error-handling paths (e.g., the `free_eit` label), the code previously could call both `vidtv_psi_*_table_destroy()` and `vidtv_psi_*_event_destroy()` on the same memory, leading to a double-free or use-after-free. By clearing the local pointers, subsequent `destroy` operations on them become safe (as they typically check for `NULL` before freeing). The fix thus eliminates the vulnerability by ensuring that the local variables no longer reference memory that has already been freed or is now owned by another structure.
